title: Law, Gospel and Church Life: Galatians, Corinthians
subtitle: Galatians, 1-2 Corinthians
theme: The sufficiency of grace. The cross as the center of everything.
memoryText: I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me.
reviewQuestions: What is the “different gospel” Paul is writing against in Galatians?
What does “justification by faith” mean practically?
Why does Paul say “I decided to know nothing among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified”?
What does the resurrection of 1 Corinthians 15 have to do with everyday Christian living?
psalmsNote: Psalms 33, 62, 111, 112, and 133 on trust, generosity, and unity.
